text_en: Thank you, I knew I could count on you for this request.
You cannot imagine the value these flowers hold.
Their curative properties are beyond imaginable, but preparing the flowers will be a complicated process. I will need need harness every ounce of focus I can.
I will try to let you know when everything is ready.
Strength, Human... I'm sorry, I believe you usually say “greetings”.
I have a favour to ask you. I know you have no reason to trust me, but I can assure you that I hold no ill intentions.
I just need you to come with me and listen to our Commander's request.
Don't worry, it's not a long journey. We're based in the outskirts of the city. After listening, you can decide whether or not to go but, right now, you're our only hope.
Commander Beliagar. As I expected, the Human has agreed to listen to us.
Greetings, hormone.
Greetings, Human. We've called you here because our friend noticed the great courage you showed in defending the city from the invasion of the dark rain.
There is much to tell and little time to act, so I'll try to be brief.

Certain motives brought us to this world. We believe that travelling here by our own means violates the rules that govern this place, which is why we keep our distance from the city's affairs. We still don't know how all of this works.
Our Floating Module is located at a considerable altitude, just above a dense layer of clouds that seem to stay completely still.

When we arrived, we came down in our shuttle to begin our research. I'm afraid I can't tell you its purpose but, unexpectedly, an enemy took advantage of the fact that most of our troops were here on the ground and boarded our module. They seem to be airborne pirates that have taken an interest in our technology.
These pirates knew what they were doing. They cut the links that would allow us to get back and took the crew who remained inside as prisoners.
I'll be honest with you, defending the city is not what has led us to seek you out, but rather the artifacts you use. Those... orbs.

During our time here, a certain trader managed to provide us with an orb that would supposedly help us. This orb can release enormous amounts of energy that would reactivate our transport systems. Unfortunately, the orb was inactive and we're unable to use it.
We think you may be able to awaken it, as you seem to be quite familiar with them. Would you mind holding it, please?
It's not working...
We suspected this would happen. After all, these artifacts are entirely new to us.

I'm sorry to overwhelm you, Human, but do you believe you could find a way to activate it? Magic is something that escapes our understanding, but we are aware that there are beings in the city who do possess such knowledge.
Unfortunately, we're not exactly adept at dealing with Hafin's inhabitants. Most of them seem to fear us... Do you think you could find someone with magical abilities that could awaken its power?
Think about it, Human... You may keep the orb until you return. It's not particularly useful to us in its current state. We'll be here if you make progress.

Oh! Sorry, sorry! Have you been stood there long? These writings have me completely absorbed. You can't imagine the magical knowledge these volumes hold. We couldn't even dream of such wisdom back in Zarga.
And all of it's possible right here, where we stand right now! The amount of energy that flows through Terragaya is immense in comparison.
Hmm?
Ah... I see. It's not the books that have brought you here, per se. You need to know if there's a way to restore an object's hidden powers.
Well, I'm sorry to tell you that those types of spells are simply impossible...
I'm joking! I was pulling your leg! The look on your face was priceless.
Luckily for you, it looks like pulling off something like that is Magic 101 in this world. The first book I read already featured several studies on how to perform an “energetic awakening”.
Right, shall we get started?
Done! That'll be a thousand gold coins, please.
It's a joke! I'm joking! Oh, aren't you just a gem?

As your superior, I should be demanding an explanation as to why you're in possession of an element like that, and no, that's not a joke. But I have been keeping track of your achievements under General Brigard's command. He has nothing but praise for you, did you know that? So, I'll trust you. I can only hope you don't get into trouble while Jivan tries to cure our soldiers.
It's been a pleasure putting this knowledge into practice. If you need something else in the future, don't hesitate to come back.
You've done it! I knew you would return with the activated orb!
Just as the trader said, it emits a huge amount of electrical energy, far more than our magnetic pulses do. This is more than enough energy to activate the transporter.

Do you see that beacon on top of our pod? Jump up there. Once you're there, use the orb on the charger's central gemstone. It's an inactive mineral that you can easily recharge to restore the pod's energy.
Just a moment!
Human, were you spying on us?!
No!_100_ I mean..._100_ yes..._100_ but for good reason.
Soldier! Why didn't you tell me about all this?
I'm bored stiff in this city. I need action!
No need to ask, I'm in on the plan! Together we are stronger!
Our achievements will go down in history!
You won't be coming, Humans. Once you activate the transporter for us, we won't have any further need for you.
Do you really think we soldiers of Zarga are going to let you go up there without backup? You clearly don't know us very well.
Right, soldier?
Are you really willing to risk your lives to help us?
Absolutely! Irka could do with stretching his legs.
Alright, we appreciate Zarga's bravery.
I've got something to ask in exchange for our help.
What is it that you need, Human?
If we pull this off, I want you to let my friend here keep that... sparkly... thing... You know, that ball you lent him.
The spark orb?
Yes, that.
I have no problem with that. You may keep it.
Great! When do we leave?
Alright, soldier, when you are ready, jump onto the platform and activate the central gemstone.
